title: Balance Sheet Dynamics Chart 2: Asset Composition

data.item: Balance Sheet Dynamics Customer deposits grew moderately by 3.3% y/y to KES 431.91Bn. In contrast, the loan book contracted 4.7% y/y to KES 267.86Bn , resulting in a 520bps y/y decline in the loan deposit ratio to 62.0%. Notably, management strategically reduced its allocation to government securities by 11.1% y/y to KES 118.10Bn in a move to capitalize of favorable margins in customer assets while maintaining adequate liquidity. Eroding Operating Efficiency Operating efficiency eroded as reflected by the cost-to-income (excluding loan- loss provisions) increasing by 100bps y/y to 51.6%. The deterioration was primarily driven by the pre-provision operating expenses growing at 12.4% y/y, outpacing the 10.3% y/y increase in operating income. The increase in expenses stemmed from the lender's strategic investments in upgrading core digital infrastructure and the rising staff costs linked to branch expansion efforts. Additionally, the cost of assets ratio (excluding loan-loss provisions) increased 20bps y/y to 1.8%, highlighting the impact of higher non-credit related costs on the bank's operational efficiency. Outlook We remain optimistic about the lender's growth prospects, supported by strong performance from its subsidiaries, ongoing digital transformation efforts, and strategic branch network expansion. The adoption of risk-based loan pricing is expected to enhance interest income and promote organic growth in the loan portfolio. While we anticipate a temporary rise in operating expenses due to the opening of new branches, we believe these investments will contribute to sustained revenue growth over the long term.

data.item: Recommendation • We maintain our HOLD recommendation on Diamond Trust Bank on account of lackluster growth on its return on equity. At the current market price, the stock is trading at P/E ratio of 1.5x and a P/B ratio of 0.2x. Our one-year target price for Diamond Trust Bank currently stands at KES 52.31 - representing a c.14.8% upside potential from current levels.
